Sir,

March    11,    31

Sir,

    I have the honour to forward herewith a
letter dated February 10, 1931, from Calcutta,
asking for information regarding the circumstances
under which a visa to India was granted to one Etienne
Finardi.  I have already acknowledged receipt of this
letter, and shall be glad if you will kindly send a
formal reply direct to the Deputy Commissioner of Police,
Detective Department, Calcutta.

                        I have the honour to be,
                                Sir,
                        Your obedient servant,

                        for Commissioner of Police.

H.B.M. Consul General,
    Shanghai.

（批：Encl:- 1）

先生：

谨此随函附上一封1931年2月10日发自加尔各答的信件，信中询问有关向一名名为 Etienne Finardi 的人士签发印度签证的情况。本人已确认收到此信，如蒙阁下直接向加尔各答侦缉处副警务总监发出正式回复，将不胜感激。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

代警务总监。

Office of the Commr: of Police, Calcutta.
Detective Department.

No. 867 DD dated 10th February 1931.

The Chief Police Officer,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to state that a French subject
called Etienne Rinardi, who is suspected to be a pimp or
procurer of some French prostitutes in Calcutta, arrived
here about a month ago from Saigon and Shanghai for the
purpose of, as stated by him, searching for his wife Marie
Rinardi alias Lulu Rinardi, a prostitute in Calcutta.
He left with his wife for Saigon from Colombo on the 5th
February 1931. Rinardi was in possession of a French
passport No. 95 issued at Saigon on the 8th April 1930 and
visaed for India by the British Consul at Shanghai on the
23rd June 1930.

I would now request that you will be so good as
to ascertain and let me know the circumstances under which
a visa for India was granted to this man.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your most obedient servant,
(Sd) H.C. Hunt
Dy: Commissioner of Police.

（左侧手写批注：）
x Sir,
10 March in

加尔各答警务总监办公室。
侦缉处。

1931年2月10日第867 DD号。

上海警务处长。

先生：

谨此陈述，一名名为 Etienne Rinardi 的法国籍人士，涉嫌在加尔各答充当皮条客或为某些法国妓女拉客，约一个月前从西贡和上海抵达此处，据其自称，目的是寻找其在加尔各答从事妓女行业的妻子 Marie Rinardi（又名 Lulu Rinardi）。他与其妻于1931年2月5日从科伦坡前往西贡。Rinardi 持有一本1930年4月8日在西签发的第95号法国护照，并于1930年6月23日由英国驻上海领事馆加签了印度签证。

现恳请阁下查明并告知此人获得印度签证的具体情况。

谨此致意，
先生，
您最顺从的仆人，
(签名) H.C. Hunt
副警务总监。

（左侧手写批注：）
x 先生，
